regional_summary_6h.headline: Greece rescues 26 migrants off Gavdos; Iran rejects talks as Damascus retakes Russian bases
bullets: Greek authorities conducted a rescue operation for 26 migrants south of Gavdos island.
Iran's Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi stated Tehran will not resume negotiations while Washington violates the interim agreement.
Damascus has retaken control of Hmeimeem Airport and Tartous berth following a reorganization of Russian military presence.
regional_summary_6h.watch: Monitor Iranian diplomatic posture and Syrian base transitions for spillover effects on Turkish border security.
